title: Vehicle Performance Impressions
summary: Reviews in this topic mostly describe favorable impressions of G70 performance, while several fragments are too brief or incomplete to determine clear sentiment.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise strong road performance, enjoyable power, and satisfying overall driving characteristics.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention performance or handling in vague or incomplete terms without enough context for a clear sentiment judgment.

limitations: The topic is narrowly centered on performance comments, but several fragments are very short or truncated, which limits sentiment interpretation.
The examples are all from the US G70 sample only, so they do not support broader conclusions beyond these fragments.
